PROGRAM_LEDGER.rule: Main declares active frontiers, project state and global decisions.

SPATIAL_DOMAIN_FABRIC.rule: WorldAddress and cross-domain spatial mappings are global foundation contracts.

MATERIAL_ONTOLOGY.rule: MaterialDefinitionId and canonical material definitions are shared global contracts.

WORLD_TRANSACTION_MODEL.rule: Cross-domain Item/Matter/Construction operation semantics are global foundation contracts.

ITEM_IDENTITY_AND_GRAPH.rule: Item domain owns permanent Item identities and Item Graph semantics.

MATTER_TRUTH.rule: Matter owns authoritative mutable material/volume truth and durable Matter transactions.

GEO_PROCEDURAL_BASELINE.rule: World Generation owns deterministic procedural baseline and Geo feature/field contracts.

AUTHORITY_FOUNDATION.rule: Domain branches consume authority policy; they do not invent permanent owner registries.

NETWORK_REPLICATION_POLICY.rule: Network owns transport/replication policy, not gameplay truth.

PERSISTENCE_DURABILITY.rule: New async I/O must preserve existing commit/replay/recovery semantics.

DERIVED_PRESENTATION.rule: Renderer/HLOD/rig/mesh artifacts are disposable derived representations.

COMPUTE_EXECUTION.rule: Workers compute proposals; authority validates and commits.

WORLD_WORK_BUDGET.rule: Local laboratory throttles must not become a hidden global scheduler foundation.

WORLD_QUERY_FABRIC.rule: Domain queries may exist, but no branch may silently claim universal World Query ownership.
